title: Authorization attestation and audit evidence runbook for private deployments
creator: Rhea Kumar
description: Create an executable runbook and acceptance checklist that ties authorization controls (SSO/SAML, RBAC policies, delegated approvers) and key management (KMS/HSM) to concrete audit evidence for private/VPC/on-prem customer onboarding. The goal is to reduce manual evidence collection by 60% via automated attestations and to provide a defensible mapping from controls to artifacts for SOC2/ISO audits.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: A sample customer tenant demonstrates federated SAML login using customer's IdP with assertion validation logs retained for 90 days and a proof artifact (SAML metadata snapshot + signed login trace) added to the evidence bundle.

RBAC: Operator and tenant-level RBAC policies exported as human-readable manifests; we can produce a time-stamped policy diff showing role bindings at the time of onboarding. Evidence includes role-binding export and automated policy-scan report with severity <= 'medium' for onboarding acceptance.

Delegated approval flow: The platform supports a delegated approver workflow for privileged actions (key rotation, emergency access) with an attestable approval event stored in audit logs and visible in the Console for reviewers. Example evidence: approval event id with approver identity, timestamp, and related ticket link.

KMS/HSM: Customer key lifecycle is documented end-to-end. Acceptance requires a demonstrable key creation, rotation, and backup test using the configured KMS/HSM integration; evidence includes KMS audit entry hashes and an operator-run HSM failover simulation log.

Audit logs: Tenant-level audit streams (authn/authz, key ops, administrative changes) are configured to forward to customer-controlled destinations or to the platform with retention metadata. Evidence items: sample log export, checksum (SHA256) of export, and retention policy config snapshot.

Evidence automation: At least 4 of 7 required evidence artifacts (SAML snapshot, policy export, approval event, KMS audit, log export, attestation digest, onboarding questionnaire) are automatically produced by the onboarding pipeline; the rest are flagged as manual with explicit next steps.
Compliance mapping: Each evidence artifact is mapped to control identifiers for SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO27001 Annex A. Mapping is stored in the runbook and is human-readable in the Console export.

Operator runbook: An operator-facing sequence for verifying evidence (including commands, expected outputs, and escalation points) exists and is tested in a dry-run rehearsal with the solutions team. Rehearsal notes are attached as evidence.
Sign-off: Legal, Security, and Solutions Engineering each add a signed acceptance comment (name + date) to the Linear ticket before release to 'Done'.
